# VCS {.unnumbered}

A practical library for **version control**. Each part stands on its own: Git the tool, GitHub the product, Jujutsu, and other forges.

```text
VCS
├── Git          mental model → remotes → internals → recovery
├── GitHub       product: PRs, Actions, security, orgs, API
├── Jujutsu      seed: jj (full part later)
└── Forges       GitLab, Gitea
```

## Who this is for

| Path | Start here |
|------|------------|
| **New to version control** | Git Intro (Why Git → Mental model) → Install → First repository |
| **Daily Git, shaky on history** | Git: Commits and history → Rebasing → Troubleshooting |
| **GitHub / open source** | GitHub part (after remotes) |
| **Scale / enterprise Git** | Git: Performance and scale → Security |
| **Jujutsu** | Jujutsu seed (full rewrite later) |
| **GitLab / Gitea** | Forges |

## How to use

1. Expand a **part** in the sidebar (Git, GitHub, Jujutsu, Forges).
2. Work front-to-back for a full course, or jump to a single chapter.
3. Keep the Git **cheatsheet** open while practicing; use search when you know the command name.
4. Treat conflict and recovery chapters as drills — break a toy repo on purpose.

## Formats

HTML, PDF, and EPUB when built via the monorepo portal (`./indipub.sh VCS` from `books/`).
